tabs.title: Work Experience
content: My journey in web development includes working on a variety of projects using React, WordPress, and SASS. I have built custom WordPress themes using PHP, ensuring high standards of SEO and security. I led the Call Me Guide project, where I spearheaded frontend development with React, and managed backend tasks with Laravel and PHP for server-side logic.
Before transitioning to web development, I spent 10 years as a journalist, authored a travel book, and led adventure tours across Africa.
